dct_title_s: Independence Quadrangle, Minnesota-St. Louis County, 1953: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Independence quadrangle topographic map (N4652.5-W9222.5/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in pencil and red ink regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the Independence area. The hand written notations include information on the following; Duluth and Northeastern Railroad Company, and logging camps noted with 'C'.
